attchmntText: Euro Panel Products Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Euro Panel Products Limited approved standalone and consolidated unaudited financial results for the half year and quarter ended September 30, 2026. The Board meeting was held on November 14, 2026. Standalone revenue from operations for the quarter was 15,205.75 lakhs, with a profit before tax of 728.90 lakhs and basic earnings per share of 2.21. Consolidated revenue from operations for the half year was 27,168.16 lakhs, with a profit before tax of 1,425.29 lakhs and basic earnings per share of 4.24. The company acquired a 70% stake in Eurobonc Dimensions Private Limited for 17,50,000. The trading window for insiders closed on October 01, 2026, and will reopen 48 hours after the financial results declaration. The financial statements were reviewed by independent auditors Jogin Raval & Associates.
